title: Unrattify
description: A fabric 1.21.5+ mod that helps prevent your minecraft account being stolen by bad actors!
body:
This minecraft mod helps prevent malicious mods from stealing your account.

This mod DOES NOT prevent against malware.
This mod DOES NOT protect your files.
This mod DOES NOT mean you cannot get your account stolen.

This mod only HELPS prevent against a few types of malicious mods, it does NOT mean you cannot ever have your account taken.
Using this mod does NOT mean that you can be careless about what mods you download. It is just another layer of protection.

This mod MAY break other some other mods. However in my personal experience, it does not.

Upon detecting a potential account stealer, this mod will abruptly exit the game and log what tried to potentially steal your account.

If you have any issues with this mod, please contact me on discord @ YodaForce157
